CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Say Attributes of God has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Attributes of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Attributes of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of God.

   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

11. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Patriarchs Abraham? (1 mark)

   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons
